import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
print(w.work_id.nunique(), w.year.isna().sum())
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
d=w.dropna(subset=['year'])
t=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','size']).unstack();print(t)
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print(est(d))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp={k:v for k,v in d.groupby(['genre','late'])}
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([v.sample(len(v),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for v in grp.values()])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for col in ['origin','date_confidence']:
  print(col); print(d.groupby([col,'late']).r.mean().unstack())
hc=d[d.date_confidence=='high'];print('high',est(hc))
print(d.groupby('decade').r.mean())
print(d[(d[c]>0)&d.late].work_id.head(4).tolist(), d[(d[c]>0)&d.late].passage_ids.head(4).tolist())
